say.en: A safe body temperature, a pass mark that is not too low, a mixture of the right strength: many real limits have two ends. In this lesson: Solve a is less than px plus q is less than b.
Model word problems with inequalities.
Exam layer: |x - a| is less than r.

body.en: In $a \le px + q < b$, do the same operation to all three parts. Subtract $q$ throughout, then divide by $p$; if $p < 0$, reverse both signs. Exam layer: $|x - a| < r$ means $a - r < x < a + r$, and $|x - a| > r$ means $x < a - r$ or $x > a + r$.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿಮುಖ ಅಸಮತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಂತವನ್ನು ಮೂರೂ ಭಾಗಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಮಾಡಿ. |x − a| < r ಎಂದರೆ a − r < x < a + r.

problem.en: How many litres of a 2% acid solution must be added to 640 L of an 8% solution so that the mixture is between 4% and 6% acid?

answer.en: More than 320 L but less than 1280 L

narration.en: Let us solve this together. How many litres of a 2% acid solution must be added to 640 L of an 8% solution so that the mixture is between 4% and 6% acid?

say.en: Let us solve this together. How many litres of a 2 percent acid solution must be added to 640 L of an 8 percent solution so that the mixture is between 4 percent and 6 percent acid?
Acid equals 0.08 times 640 plus 0.02x equals 51.2 plus 0.02x in 640 plus x litres.
0.04640 plus x is less than 51.2 plus 0.02x so 0.02x is less than 25.6 so x is less than 1280.
51.2 plus 0.02x is less than 0.06640 plus x so 12.8 is less than 0.04x so x is greater than 320.
So the answer is More than 320 L but less than 1280 L.
